subject.title: [F5] has_fallback=false despite model retry chains — fallback storms invisible in traces

question: Which open fallback telemetry PR should be treated as the canonical fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, but two open PRs attempt the same source-level repair and automation should not choose a landing branch when one PR has closing syntax and another has stronger proof/coverage.

options.title: Use the proof-sufficient shared-observer PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102051 as canonical, land it after normal maintainer review, and close or supersede sibling PRs.

options.title: Use the existing closing PR
options.body: Continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102046 if maintainers prefer that branch, after its proof gap is resolved or overridden.

options.title: Pause for broader telemetry direction
options.body: Hold all sibling PRs if maintainers want a new `has_fallback` attribute or broader backoff/circuit-breaker design beyond the existing event contract.

recommendation.title: Use the proof-sufficient shared-observer PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102051 as canonical, land it after normal maintainer review, and close or supersede sibling PRs.
